column4: Guarantees your next spell will be a critical hit after you block three spells within 10 seconds of each other.
Increases your Spell Critical rating by 3%.
Reduces the Magicka cost of your next spell by 80% after you drink a potion.
Gives you a 20% chance when you kill an enemy of opening an Arcane Well, which restores [x] Magicka up to three allies within 2.5 meters of the enemy.
